newsitem.title: USA: Competitive gets impotence treatment patent.
newsitem.headline: Competitive gets impotence treatment patent.

text.p: Competitive Technologies Inc said on Tuesday that U.S. Patent Office has issued a patent for a technology invented by the University of Arizona to treat psychogenic erectile dysfunction.

Competitive Tech, which represents the University of Arizona as the exclusive licensing agent for this technology, said that the invention utilizes a peptide hormone analog designed by university professors to diagnose and treat psychogenic erectile dysfunction.
According to the company, there are over 100 million men worldwide who suffer from impotence.

Competitive Tech said it is working with the University of Arizona to locate a licensee with the financial capability and technical resources to take the peptide through the regulatory process and into the marketplace.
It said that the University of Arizona invention provides the only known patented method for the rapid and precise differentiation of physiological and psychological impotence.
